content: कामतः, कामेन {%ind.%} .²1 Of oneʼs own accord, willingly. .²2 Voluntarily, knowingly, intentionally, wilfully; <ls>Ms. 4. 130</ls>; पदा स्पृष्टं च कामतः <ls>Y. 1. 168</ls>. .²3 From passion or feeling, lustfully; भ्रातुर्मृतस्य भार्यायां योऽनुरज्येत कामतः <ls>Ms. 3. 173</ls>. .²4 At will, freely, unrestrained.
